explanation: Visit cells recursively, skipping clues and trying each legal digit in an empty cell. Validate a choice against its row, column and subgrid, then undo it if later choices fail.
timeComplexity: Exponential; O(n^(e+3)) is a conservative bound for n×n boards with e empty cells
spaceComplexity: O(n²) maximum recursion depth, including visits to clue cells
